body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create original Foxmint 1.7 2000 compact three-door sport COUPE game sprite sheet for 2994 abandoned world. Reference only for worn painted texture, transparent open wheel arches and eight-angle sheet, NOT its design. A distinctly shorter narrower petite rounded coupe, short smooth hood, high curved bubble roof tapering to stubby sloped hatchback tail, oval angular leaf-shaped headlights, triangular rear lamps, one long side door and single handle per side, rounded triangular rear quarter windows. Faded mint-green body with rusted burgundy replacement hood and small repaired cream panels. No spoiler, no side vents, no racing bodykit, no logos or words. Exactly eight consistent orthographic views in four columns/two rows, same layout as reference: front, front quarter nose left, side nose left, rear quarter nose right; rear, rear quarter nose left, side nose right, front quarter nose right. Wide 3:1 sheet, each separated fully inside cell. NO tires or wheels, wheel cutouts must be genuinely transparent open to bottom silhouette. Genuine transparent background no ground/shadows/scenery/text.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Foxmint 1.7 2000 RIGHT HAND DRIVE compact sport coupe cockpit overlay. Reference only for worn 2994 salvage paint style and RHD layout. Distinct curving low charcoal dashboard with faded mint-green fascia and burgundy repair patches, slim oval vents, simple small central radio/climate console and left passenger glovebox. Large blank OPAQUE BLACK driver instrument binnacle on RIGHT, source canvas 1983x793 approximately x1170..1750 y410..650. No gauges/dials/numbers/text painted in black binnacle. Absolutely NO steering wheel, steering column or hands; runtime draws them. Windshield above dashboard genuinely transparent; only far-edge thin sideposts, no roof across top, no scenery. Wide 2.5:1. Straight-on cockpit overlay, dashboard lower half. Clean alpha, no logos or emblems.
